name: future-english-center
description: FUTURE ENGLISH CENTER — Master English. Unlock Your Future.

scripts.db:setup: npm run db:push -w backend && npm run db:seed -w backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n db,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run db:local -w backend" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
